title: Register changes after generated Helm values, V2-S2-001-PR2
description: What V2-S2-001-PR2 changed in the register once the platform generated Helm values and the release naming them: every register change with its value before and after, and the findings each answers. It is the second ledger written after v1.0.0 was released, and like the first it is not part of the pack that release was cut over: the evidence index undoes it, with the post-release ledger, to recompute that pack. It promotes no claim, adds no record, raises and closes no blocker, declares no freeze, states no release, and edits no dated record.

registerChanges.before: Deployment rendering does not exist. The chart's values are written by an operator, not derived from a document.
registerChanges.after: Deterministic deployment-value rendering exists, checked statically at C0: validated, typed inputs render the chart's values, and a RenderedWorkloadRelease binds the generated values file to the digests and revisions of what it was rendered from. No supported deployment or GitOps path consumes the generated files yet, so no executed release shows deployment values derived only from a validated document. The platform-defaults revision a release records is the one its caller states: nothing yet reconstructs the defaults from a committed source bound to that revision, so defaults content changed under the same stated revision changes the values and not the release identifier. A hand-written values file is checked against the generated values only when it is one the repository supports, one named with the .manual-values.yaml suffix; any other values file given to Helm is not checked.
registerChanges.reason: The renderer and the generated release exist, so the limitation says what exists, at what level, and what still stands between it and the statement: no deployment path consumes the generated files, the platform defaults are named by an asserted revision, and only supported hand-written values files are checked.

findings.observation: The claim's limitation said deployment rendering does not exist and that the chart's values are written by an operator. Since the Helm values renderer and the generated release, deterministic rendering from validated, typed inputs exists, and a RenderedWorkloadRelease binds the generated values to their sources; both are static, C0. The sentence was left stale by the change that added the renderer, which said so in its record, and was left stale again by this change's first commit.
findings.resolution: The limitation is replaced. The claim stays planned, asserts no real behaviour, and cites no record: no supported deployment path consumes the generated files, so the statement is not shown by any executed release.

findings.observation: The register's reason for the evidence index, a surface that claims nothing, named five ledgers of register changes and said the released pack is recomputed by undoing the post-release ledger. This ledger is a sixth, and it is undone too.
findings.resolution: The reason is replaced; the surface claims nothing.
